hypothesis: Restrict setup closes to 10:00 ET onward improves net dollar expectancy versus unchanged baseline.
single_change: Earliest eligible setup close: 09:45 -> 10:00 America/New_York. Entry cutoff, expiry, levels, fills, costs, exits and daily cap unchanged.
limitations: Exploratory full-sample test, not independent validation. UTC minute-close convention and roll adjustments unverified. Full-session selection bias and minute-OHLC fill uncertainty remain.
